name: small-plans
description: /small-plans breaks work into small, self-contained plans a weaker model can implement and review, saved as Markdown files under ~/.claude/small-plans/<project>/<set>/; the work is what you name, what the conversation leaves, or with handoff what a saved handoff leaves; build has small-model agents implement and review each plan of a set; open shows every plan in the shared notes viewer, one local web page with handoffs, project notes, small plans and brainstorm plans in its sidebar, sorted by project, set and build order, with its kind and status
